description:
Create a multi-screen mobile app wireframe for a public transit app called 'CityTransit GO' based on the Product Requirements Document (PRD) provided at ~/Desktop/transit_app_prd.txt. 

Starting from the blank file ~/Diagrams/transit_app_wireframe.drawio, you must create 5 separate pages in the diagram (Home, Trip Planner, Route Results, Route Detail, Alerts). 

Follow the PRD strictly for layout, specific text labels, and UI components (buttons, input fields, tab bars, lists). 

Use draw.io's Mockup or General shape libraries to create realistic mobile wireframes (approximate phone aspect ratio). 

Establish navigation flows between screens using arrows (either on the specific pages or an overview page). 

Finally, export the result as a PNG image to ~/Diagrams/transit_app_wireframe.png.
